text: DAEN 328 Data Engineering for Humans Credits: 3. 3 Lecture Hours. Overview: 3 Lecture Hours. Human considerations and constraints for data engineering, including human factors of data visualization; data processing and analysis of human physiological, psychological and performance data; the role of human biases in model development, analysis and interpretation; human factors of interactions with machine learning-based artificial intelligence tools in complex systems such as healthcare, manufacturing and transportation. Prerequisites: Junior senior classification. Prerequisite: Junior senior classification.
